channel.title: South Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: South Sudan agrees to transfer Petronas oil shares to Russia
item.description: Zarubezhneft will take over stakes in DPOC and GPOC following Petronas' withdrawal.

item.title: South Sudanese children demand climate action
item.description: Young participants in a Juba consultation called for climate-resilient schools and early warning systems.

item.title: South Sudan secures $267 million for Ugandan electricity
item.description: The funding will extend power from Nimule to Juba and other major towns, aiming to boost reliability and affordability.

item.title: South Sudan to hold state funeral for General Joseph Lagu in Juba
item.description: The family of the late General Joseph Lagu Yanga has accepted President Salva Kiir's offer of a state funeral and burial in the capital.

item.title: Riek Machar praises late General Joseph Lagu
item.description: Machar, detained in a cell, called Lagu a selfless leader who prioritized peace and self-determination.
